earlier_scan.source_named: Glottolog lists only classification notes (Asonye 2016, Nyst 2010); no grammar or phonology of Guinea-Bissau Sign Language found

sources.citation: Morgado Pereira, Marta Dias da Silva (2024). Personal experience narratives in three West African sign languages. PhD dissertation, Leiden University (LOT/Leiden repository). 551 pp.
sources.note: Only book-length linguistic work covering LGG; its language-background chapter may contain the fullest structural sketch of LGG (though a stress statement is not expected for a sign language).

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority (2022). Change Request Number 2022-002: create [lgs] Lingua Gestual Guineense (adopted 2023-01-20). SIL International. 5 pp.
sources.note: Nothing; administrative code request. States LGG 'has been emerging since 2005' and lists three references (Martins, Morgan & Nyst in press on argument structure; Martins, Soares & Barros 2021; Martins & Morgado 2017 dictionary).

sources.citation: Martins, M., Soares, A. & Barros, M. (2021). The incorporation of emblematic gestures in the emerging sign language of Guinea-Bissau. WOCAL 2021 abstract (OSF, DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/37HRQ).
sources.note: Nothing; one-page abstract on lexicalisation/grammaticalisation of emblematic gestures in LGG. No phonology or prosody.

sources.citation: Martins, M., Morgan, H. E. & Nyst, V. (in press, c. 2022). Argument structure in the emerging sign language of Guinea-Bissau. In A. M. Brito & C. Morgado (eds.), Proceedings of the 3rd Meeting on Morphosyntax of Portuguese Sign Language and other sign languages. Porto.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: Only grammatical (morphosyntactic) study of LGG cited in the ISO request; not expected to treat prosody but is the closest thing to a structural description.

sources.citation: Nyst, Victoria (2010). Sign languages in West Africa. In D. Brentari (ed.), Sign Languages (Cambridge Language Surveys), 405-432. CUP.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: Regional overview that mentions LGG; would confirm absence of phonological description.

sources.citation: Morgado, Marta & Martins, Mariana (2008). Dicionario escolar de lingua gestual guineense. Lisboa: Surd'Universo. 144 pp; Martins & Morgado (2017) Dicionario Pratico de Lingua Gestual Guineense. Lisboa: Surd'Universo.
sources.tag: not read: abstract or record only
sources.note: Print-only sign dictionaries; no indication of a phonology/prosody section.
